remarks:
Welcome to Buck Hollow Lodge! Escape to your own private lodge with this breathtaking custom home, perfectly blending rugged, rustic charm with modern luxury. Featuring extensive natural wood finishes, soaring ceilings, and abundant natural light, this fully furnished property is an absolute dream for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts looking for a peaceful sanctuary. This incredible property is located on the Cattaragus/Chautauqua county line just minutes from Frewsburg, Onoville, the Allegheny Reservoir and state lands. Nestled among nearly 10 acres of pure seclusion and serenity.

Spend time outdoors with family and friends creating lifelong memories. Whether you're enjoying the covered area or open air space on the wrap around deck there is room for everyone. Gather around the fire pit, enjoy your BBQ in the built in gazebo, relax under the sun or stars. The expansive outdoor living space has an area for everyone to enjoy. 

Spectacular Great Room: The heart of the home features magnificent vaulted wood ceilings with exposed timber beams, rich hardwood floors, and a show-stopping floor-to-ceiling river stone fireplace. 

Gourmet Kitchen & Dining: Entertain with ease in the beautifully updated kitchen, boasting stainless steel appliances, striking granite countertops, and custom two-tone cabinetry. The adjoining dining space is ideal for sit down dinners and ease of service.

Breathtaking Primary Suite: Wake up to unparalleled views of the surrounding nature through a massive wall of windows. This spacious retreat features vaulted wood ceilings, a ceiling fan, and private access to the outdoors. This en suite includes a large walk in closet and full bathroom. 

Cozy Lower Level: The finished lower level is designed for ultimate relaxation. It features a family room and  secondary kitchenette/bar area.  There are 2 bedrooms and a full bath as well. 

Bonus room: A separate entrance leads to a "hunting room" with bunk area, full bath and storage space for your gear. After a day spent in your woods it's a great space to unwind and celebrate your hunt!

Features: New driveway, central air, shed, wood stove, high speed internet and so much more
